name: Synthetic quarterly earnings: distinguish guidance and one broker estimate

sourceParts.name: Synthetic company release.txt
sourceParts.content: For Q1 FY2027, Example Company reported revenue of $540 million. Full-year FY2027 revenue guidance is $2.20 billion to $2.30 billion. The prior range was $2.10 billion to $2.20 billion. These figures are reported company guidance, not consensus estimates.

sourceParts.name: Synthetic broker note.txt
sourceParts.content: For Q1 FY2027, our individual broker revenue estimate was $520 million. This is a single analyst estimate and should not be described as market consensus.

good.markdown: Q1 FY2027 revenue was $540 million versus an individual broker estimate of $520 million. FY2027 guidance is $2.20–2.30 billion.

claims.quote: For Q1 FY2027, Example Company reported revenue of $540 million.

bad.markdown: Q1 FY2027 revenue was $540 billion versus consensus of $520 million. FY2027 guidance is $2.20–2.30 billion.
